ops.body: 2026-10-13 00:50 PT. Merged as d4fb22525aee69769fc4c41db5f4e9960fb7a437 and released as 14.41.0. One independent finder (gpt-6.1-sol) passed the committed diff with no findings; CI compiled it for the first time and needed no fix round. Criterion 1 stays pending on purpose: CI ran `cargo build` and `cargo test -p cc-transcript-core` only with --no-default-features (849 passed, all 15 observer regressions among them). With default features the core compiles (py crate tests, stub_gen and the wheel build), but no CI job runs the core test suite that way, so the `cfg!(feature = "command")` arm of glob_and_regex_kinds_answer_only_as_the_primary_while_the_other_eight_settle_as_observers, which expects a definite `false` from a has_command observer, has not run. captain-hook PR #361 carries a test that sends has_command observers through the published default-feature wheel; its CI result is the evidence for that arm.
